server.name: Saffron Language Server
server.description:
Saffron's language server (saffron lsp from the saffron-ai npm package): step completion with recorded/divergent/unrecorded badges, StepSet completion and go-to-definition, hover cards, and diagnostics for .saffron and .feature files.

Needs saffron-ai installed in the project (npm i -D saffron-ai).
